enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Pull the pillow with the left hand. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Extend the right arm. Move the legs. Turn onto the back. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the right side again. Remain lying down. Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor.

Stand up from the bed. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Turn on the tap again. Wash the face with both hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the shirt. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard. Take out the bowl. Take out the cereal box. Close the cupboard. Pour cereal into the bowl. Pour milk into the bowl. Pick up the spoon. Sit down on the chair at the table. Eat the cereal with the spoon. Pick up the bowl. Drink the remaining milk. Stand up. Carry the bowl and spoon to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl and spoon. Turn off the tap. Place the bowl and spoon on the drying rack.

Walk to Bedroom 1. Pull the curtain open. Pick up the blanket. Fold the blanket. Place the blanket on the bed. Pick up the pillow. Place the pillow at the head of the bed. Pick up clothes from the floor. Fold the clothes. Open the wardrobe door. Place the clothes on the shelf. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the phone from the desk. Place the phone in the bag. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the desk with the cloth. Place the cloth on the shelf.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the shops by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the bag. Put on the jacket. Open the front door. Close the front door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Pick up the phone. Press the button to check the timetable. Place the phone in the pocket. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Sit down on the seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk off the bus. Walk to the shop entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping and paying in cash
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up a trolley. Push the trolley into the first aisle. Pick up a bag of apples. Place the apples in the trolley. Pick up a loaf of bread. Place the bread in the trolley. Pick up a carton of milk. Place the milk in the trolley. Pick up a bag of rice. Place the rice in the trolley. Pick up the vegetables. Place the vegetables on the scale. Press the button for the label. Place the vegetables in the trolley. Push the trolley to the checkout. Lift the items onto the counter. Open the purse. Take out the cash notes. Hand the cash to the cashier. Receive the change. Count the change. Place the change into the purse. Close the purse. Place the items into the bag. Pick up the bag. Walk out of the shop.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the shops by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Board the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Sit down on the seat. Place the bag on the lap. Hold the bag with both hands. Stand up at the stop. Walk off the bus. Walk to the front door. Take out the keys. Unlock the door. Open the front door. Close the front door.

Place the bag on the counter. Open the bag. Take out the milk. Open the refrigerator door. Place the milk on the shelf. Close the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Open the crisper drawer. Place the vegetables in the drawer. Close the drawer. Take out the rice. Open the cupboard. Place the rice on the shelf. Close the cupboard. Take out the bread. Place the bread in the bread box. Fold the bag. Place the bag in the drawer.

Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lettuce. Take out the tomatoes. Take out the cheese. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the tomatoes. Cut the lettuce. Cut the cheese. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the vegetables and cheese on the plate. Pick up the plate. Place the plate on the table. Place the knife on the board.

Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Pick up the food with the fork. Place the food in the mouth. Chew. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Place the glass on the table. Pick up the fork again. Eat the remaining food. Finish the food on the plate. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate. Turn off the tap. Place the plate on the drying rack.

Walk to Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop. Press the power button. Open the browser. Log in to the university portal. Open the course reading. Scroll down the page with the mouse. Read the text. Pick up the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write notes in the notebook. Highlight text with the mouse. Open a second document. Type notes on the keyboard. Press save. Open a second tab. Read the second article. Scroll down the page.

Pick up the book from the bedside table. Sit down on the bed. Open the book at the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the next page. Turn the page again. Read another page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Stand up. Stretch both arms. Sit down on the bed again. Pick up the book. Open the book. Read another chapter. Turn the page. Close the book.

enriched_activities.activity: Planning the week and setting reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the unlock button. Open the calendar app. Tap on Monday. Type the appointment time. Tap save. Open the notes app. Type the to-do list. Open the reminder app. Set a reminder for 09:00. Set a reminder for the work shift. Pick up the paper planner. Open the planner. Pick up the pen. Write the tasks in the planner. Close the planner. Place the planner on the desk. Place the phone on the desk.

Walk to the kitchen. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the switch down. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Place a tea bag in the mug. Pick up the kettle. Pour the water into the mug. Place the kettle back on the base. Pick up the mug. Sit down on the chair at the table. Blow on the tea. Sip the tea. Place the mug on the table.

Open the refrigerator door. Take out the chicken. Take out the vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the chicken and vegetables on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the chicken on the cutting board. Cut the vegetables. Open the cupboard. Take out the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Place the chicken in the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the chicken. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Press the button to lower the heat. Open the cupboard. Take out two plates. Press the power button to turn off the cooker. Spoon the food onto the plates.

Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Pick up the knife. Cut the chicken with the knife. Place the food in the mouth. Chew. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Place the glass on the table. Pick up the fork again. Eat the vegetables. Finish the food on the plate. Stand up. Carry the plate and cutlery to the sink.

Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Press dish soap onto the sponge. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the drying rack. Wipe the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan. Place the pan in the drying rack. Wash the cutlery. Rinse the cutlery. Place the cutlery in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Wipe the table with the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook.

Walk to Bedroom 1. Sit down on the bed. Open the laptop. Press the power button. Open the streaming site in the browser. Scroll the list with the mouse. Click on a show. Click play. Lean back against the pillow. Watch the screen. Click pause. Click play again. Click the volume icon. Adjust the volume. Watch the screen. Click stop. Close the browser. Close the laptop.

Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book at the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the next page. Turn the page again. Read the next page. Move the bookmark to the current page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the phone. Check the messages. Place the phone on the desk. Sit down on the bed.

Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Take off the clothes. Place the clothes in the laundry basket. Open the shower door. Step into the shower. Turn on the tap. Adjust the temperature with the handle. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body. Pick up the shampoo. Pour shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the hair. Step out of the shower. Put on the pyjamas. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the light.

Walk to the kitchen. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the switch down. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Place a herbal tea bag in the mug. Pick up the kettle. Pour the water into the mug. Place the kettle back on the base. Pick up the mug. Sit down on the chair at the table. Sip the tea. Place the mug on the table. Stand up. Carry the mug to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mug. Turn off the tap. Place the mug on the drying rack.

Walk to Bedroom 1. Turn on the desk lamp. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the alarm app. Set the alarm for 07:30. Place the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the book. Open the book. Read a page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Turn off the desk lamp. Press the light switch to turn off the room light. Press the fan switch to turn on the fan. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body.

Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the left hand. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Remain lying down. Turn onto the left side. Move the legs. Pull the blanket up again. Lie still.
